name: Vop
summary: Vọp, which Dân Việt also writes dọp, is a shellfish a diner calls large and not too chewy, eaten with mỡ hành and peanuts. The story also shows vọp nướng. A species name was not printed.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets.
howToEat: Grilled, or with scallion oil and peanuts, at the table with the seafood lunch.
Dân Việt prints 100,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Vop — a Can Gio shellfish with scallion oil
seoDescription: Vọp, also written dọp, is a Can Gio shellfish Dân Việt serves with scallion oil and peanuts, and grilled. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
texture: The diner calls it large and not too chewy.
